description: 对经营范围关键词做交集、并集、差集

records.question: 既做布料又做钩针编织物的企业有哪些？
records.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT enterprise_name FROM firms_lite WHERE business_scope LIKE '%布料%' AND business_scope LIKE '%钩针编织物%'

records.question: 做运动服装或者毛衣的企业有哪些
records.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT enterprise_name FROM firms_lite WHERE business_scope LIKE '%运动服装%' OR business_scope LIKE '%毛衣%'

records.question: 搞印染加工却不搞无纺布的公司
records.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT enterprise_name FROM firms_lite WHERE business_scope LIKE '%印染加工%' AND NOT (business_scope LIKE '%无纺布%')

records.question: 做家纺但不做棉纱的企业
records.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT enterprise_name FROM firms_lite WHERE business_scope LIKE '%家纺%' AND NOT (business_scope LIKE '%棉纱%')
